changelog.title: What's New in 7.0.0
items: Theme Shop: browse and apply themes in-app, with 6 themes bundled and more every update
Profile switcher: right-click your profile to switch Steam accounts - login once per account
Playtime and achievements are saved separately per profile
Library now shows games only - soundtracks, tools and runtimes are filtered out
New installer: choose your install location and desktop icon
Fixed custom CSS never applying (UI Editor + theme CSS)
Fixed theme shop cards rendering with squished text

news.title: SteamLite 7.0.0 Available
news.content: Version 7.0.0 adds the in-app Theme Shop with bundled themes, a multi-account profile switcher (right-click your profile), a games-only library filter, and a new installer with install-location and desktop-icon options. All settings and playtime data carry over automatically.

news.title: SteamLite 6.0.6 Available
news.content: Version 6.0.6 was a stability and polish release: 11 bug fixes, streaming screenshots, a faster dashboard, reduced Steam API usage, and Discord Rich Presence cover art.
